question.title: Question
question.description: The question the decision model answers with a level of the scale, in natural language: "How aggressive is the user?"

resource.title: Decision model
resource.description: The decision model resource to ask

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: The levels of the scale, from the lowest, level 0, to the highest, from two to eleven. The model scores the exchange on this scale, and the guardrail applies the action of the level it scores

label.title: Label
label.description: What the level stands for, the way the model reads it: "Insulting". Unique among the levels

action.title: Action
action.description: What to do when the model scores this level: BLOCK fails the call, CONTINUE lets it through

sensitivity.title: Detection sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How readily a level that blocks does, depending on how sure the model is of the level it scores. Low: only detect clear violations, minimizing unnecessary interruptions. Balanced (recommended): balance missed violations and false alarms. High: detect potential violations, even when the evaluation is uncertain

enumLabelMap.BALANCED: Balanced (recommended): balance missed violations and false alarms
enumLabelMap.HIGH: High: detect potential violations, even when uncertain
